card: One mage-build seam (rows, ranks, level, apply) for Lab, Games and census
guards: replay-golden.test.ts and parity vectors unchanged (createGames without opponentMage)
week-census.test.ts existing cases unchanged, incl. the d1-weeks.json steady week-4 final digest
case 5 digest (lag, steady week 4, fire_heavy, 200 seeds = 6f5b913b... from d1-weeks-arm-lag.json) was reachable before via levelMages; red before only because armOption did not exist
deviations_from_card: Two commits, not three and no standalone test commit: commit 1 = mage-build.ts + tests + kernel mageVitals + lab.ts delegation + games.ts opponentMage option + index.ts export (taken under the lock); commit 2 = week-census/skill-census on the seam + the lag-digest case. A red test-only commit would not be green. The lag-digest case (case 5) lives in week-census.test.ts; the other six in mage-build.test.ts. runWeekBuildFight keeps its own loop (runBuildFight is in builds-census.ts, outside the write set). mageBuildProblems takes { level: true } to accept a level key; labBuildProblems calls it without, so a Lab build with a level still reads 'unknown key level.'. LabBuild is now Omit<MageBuild,'level'>.
notes: opponentMage is applied at the end of spawnWave's mage branch (after makeBuildRival/applyRivalHp), HP then ranks, so it also levels mages on later waves after advanceGames (levelMages only touched the first spawn; census fights are one wave, so no digest moves). Invalid level -> 'Invalid enemy level'; any other bad spec (averageRank off 1..5 halves, unknown key) -> 'Invalid opponent mage'. First full gate was red only on packages/core/src/arena/school-kit.test.ts (a sibling's untracked in-flight file); re-run ~1 min later green: 90 files, 735 vitest. core-census A: week-census.ts API kept (profileSpellRanks, opponentSpellRanks, levelMages, mageArms, runWeekFight, runWeekBuildFight) plus new armOption(week, arm).
